title: Add project auto-detection to skill
description:
Detect project code from environment when skill is invoked:

Detection order:
1. Git branch: feature/YYYY-MM-DD-XXXX-name -> extract pattern
2. Directory name: repo-YYYY-MM-DD-XXXX-name -> extract pattern  
3. Spec directory: docs/YYYY-MM-DD-XXXX-name/ -> extract from path

Pattern regex: (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[\w-]+)

User notification:
'Detected project: 2026-01-14-6453-project-dim
(from branch: feature/2026-01-14-6453-project-dim)'
